en.headline: Hong Kong firms pledge tens of millions for Tibet landslide relief
en.dek: CK Asset, CK Hutchison, Henderson Land and Sino Group each said they would give 15 million yuan through the Liaison Office disaster-relief account.
body: Several Hong Kong property and business groups have announced donations for rescue and relief work after a landslide struck Gyirong Port in Gyirong County, Shigatse, in the Tibet Autonomous Region.

CK Asset Holdings, CK Hutchison Holdings and the Li Ka-shing Foundation said they would donate 15 million yuan through the disaster-relief account of the Liaison Office of the Central People’s Government in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. Henderson Land Development and the Lee Shau Kee Foundation separately announced a 15 million yuan donation through the same channel. Sino Group and the Ng Teng Fong Charitable Foundation also said they would give 15 million yuan.

The trustees of the estate of Nina Wang pledged 10 million Hong Kong dollars for landslide-affected areas in the Tibet Autonomous Region, and Nine Dragons Paper said it would donate 10 million yuan. The companies said the funds were intended to support relief, resettlement and reconstruction. Search and rescue work was continuing, and the groups offered condolences to those killed and to people who remain unaccounted for.

zh.headline: 港商再向西藏吉隆泥石流災區捐款 長實恒地等各捐人民幣1500萬
zh.dek: 長實、長和、李嘉誠基金會，以及恒地與李兆基基金，分別經中聯辦贁災帳戶捐出人民幣1500萬元。
body: 西藏日喀則市吉隆縣吉隆口岸日前發生泥石流，港商相繼宣布捐款支援救援及災後工作。
長江實業、長江和記及李嘉誠基金會表示，將通過中央人民政府駐港聯絡辦公室贁災帳戶，向災區捐出人民幣1500萬元。恒基兆業地產及李兆基基金亦宣布經同一渠道捐出人民幣1500萬元，用於支援受災民眾。信和集團及黃廷方慈善基金同樣表示捐出人民幣1500萬元。
龔如心遺產慈善信託受託人承諾捐出1000萬港元予西藏自治區受災地區，玖龍紙業則宣布捐出人民幣1000萬元。各機構指捐款用於救災、安置及重建。搜救工作仍在進行，各機構向遇難者及失聯人士家屬致哀。
